contracts_checked: Only contiguous absolute .a arguments are collected. Every collected path must be an existing receipt-file key. The observed two runs are linker inputs, not option operands.
Each archive run is replaced in place; internal archive order is retained in response data. Whole-archive and group delimiters remain outside the response at their original relative positions.
Compiler driver, target, sysroot/search flags, linker selectors, generated object, symbol wrapping and output arguments remain unchanged.

GNU response quoting encloses each complete archive path in double quotes and escapes backslashes and double quotes. The bundled TokenizeGNUCommandLine implementation consumes this representation without JSON escape semantics; NUL is rejected.
The constructed -Wl response argument contains one literal response marker followed by the existing FD placeholder. Guard substitution leaves an inherited /proc/self/fd path for the linker.

Response data is written only through the existing memfd helper, positioned at offset zero, and verified by pread-based SHA256/size after creation and after link. No response bytes or archive path list enter persisted evidence.
The guard already reopens every registered memfd and passes all descriptors to the driver; the response descriptors use this same ownership path and are closed by the existing execute finally block.

Original/adapted argv-template hashes, per-run sequence hashes, archive counts and response content hashes bind the adaptation to the exact receipt command. Final receipt checks still rehash production archives, compiler, linker and resource inputs.
TMPDIR, diagnostic suppression, no-mmap output mode, generated output memfds, scope limits, process cleanup and no-runtime-accepted rejection semantics are unchanged.
The rejection-evidence extension adds only response hashes/counters/descriptor labels, not response contents or command text.
limitations: No compiler, linker, native run or mock suite was executed by this reviewer. Actual response-file consumption and complete anonymous linking remain required.
The observed archive placement was checked against the actual C31 receipt. The helper is not a general parser for arbitrary compiler options whose values happen to end in .a.
The earlier diagnostic establishes temporary-file failure and matching diagnostic hashes; it does not independently establish that the linker process started.
The adaptation preserves the existing provenance checks; it does not itself establish C31 correctness, SQL bag semantics or physical shared-value lineage.
